scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:clean: tsc --noEmit && vite build --outDir dist-clean --mode evalclean && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --outDir dist-clean
scripts.check:no-clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const g=(d)=>fs.readdirSync(d,{recursive:true}).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).some(f=>fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+f,'utf8').includes('observeClean')||fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+f,'utf8').includes('unprotected agent'));console.log(g('dist')?'FAIL: clean code in dist':'ok: dist has no clean-mode code')"
